summary: Iteration-5 validates 4 new CC enhancements + regression. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_features.py — 8/8 PASS. Covered: (a) reverse generic spend restores outstanding & profit, gap invariant; (b) reverse payment restores card outstanding AND credits account back (verified acc 5000->10000, card 3000->8000), gap invariant; (c) reverse refund restores outstanding, gap invariant; (d) reverse of stock-purchase-linked charge returns HTTP 400 with clear message; (e) full-payoff pay-bill zeros card, debits account by full amount, profit unchanged, gap invariant; (f) due_reminders array contains overdue + within-7-day cards ONLY (far-future and zero-outstanding excluded), each row has {card_id,name,due_date,min_due,outstanding,overdue,days_left}; (g) regression: purchase on card raises outstanding by amount, retail sale credits account full sale_price, gap invariant throughout. Notably the previously flagged accounting drifts from iter-4 are now RESOLVED — refund is netted against expenses in dashboard (total_expenses = expense-spend − refunds), and opening_outstanding is tagged category='expense' so it flows through profit. Gap invariance held across every operation. Frontend (Playwright, qatester login): due-reminders-alert banner rendered on Dashboard showing 'OVERDUE (13 Aug 2026) · min ₹500 · outstanding ₹5,000' and 'due in 3d · min ₹300 · outstanding ₹3,000'; all 5 credit strip testids present (₹53k out / ₹797k avail / ₹850k limit / 6.2% util / ₹1k upcoming); Pay Bill modal opens, selecting card with outstanding + clicking pay-full-btn auto-fills amount input to exactly card outstanding (15000); Statement panel renders with Opening/Purchases/Charges/Payments/Refunds/Closing; export-pdf-btn triggers a REAL .pdf download (QATEST_b79292_Reg-statement.pdf via jsPDF, not window.print), export-csv-btn triggers .csv download; on a stock-only card the ledger row shows 'stock' label (not a reverse button) — matches backend 400 blocking rule; no page errors during PDF/CSV export.
